task: T-Rex Runner Clone game per PRD.md, deployed to GitHub repo yjb_3

stories.title: Project scaffold + index.html boots
acceptanceCriteria: index.html exists at project root and contains <canvas id="game">
src/main.js is loaded as ES module from index.html
Opening index.html in a browser shows a 600x150 canvas with ground line drawn
No console errors on initial load (verified by syntax-check via node --check on every JS file)

stories.title: Dino character with jump + duck physics
acceptanceCriteria: Dino class implemented in src/dino.js with x, y, vy, state fields
Space/ArrowUp triggers jump with initial vy=-12, gravity 0.6 applied each frame
ArrowDown while in air triggers fast-fall (gravity multiplier increased)
ArrowDown while on ground sets ducking state with reduced hitbox height
Dino lands back on ground line and resets to running state
node --check src/dino.js passes

stories.title: Obstacle spawn system (cactus + pterodactyl)
acceptanceCriteria: src/obstacles.js implements Cactus (small/medium/large) and Pterodactyl classes
Obstacles spawn at right edge with randomized interval (min distance enforced)
Obstacles scroll left at scrollSpeed and despawn when off-screen left
Pterodactyl only spawns when score >= 700
Pterodactyl spawns at one of 3 height bands
node --check src/obstacles.js passes

stories.title: AABB collision detection + game over
acceptanceCriteria: src/collision.js exports aabb(a,b) returning boolean for AABB overlap
Collision detected between dino hitbox (shrunk for fairness) and any obstacle hitbox
On collision, game state transitions to 'gameover' and loop pauses physics
GAME OVER text rendered on canvas
Space key triggers restart from 'gameover' state
node --check src/collision.js passes

stories.title: Score, hi-score localStorage, day/night cycle
acceptanceCriteria: Score increments by ~0.1 per frame, displayed top-right padded to 5 digits
Hi score persisted in localStorage under key 'trex_hi_score'
Hi score restored on page reload and shown as 'HI 12345' to left of current score
Background colors invert every 700 score points (day <-> night)
Night mode renders moon and stars layers
Scroll speed ramps from 6 to max 12 px/frame as score increases

stories.title: Firebase global leaderboard integration (placeholder config)
acceptanceCriteria: src/leaderboard.js imports Firebase modular SDK from CDN (gstatic.com/firebasejs)
Anonymous Auth + Firestore initialized with config object containing TODO placeholders
submitScore(nickname, score, durationMs, inputCount) calls a Cloud Function endpoint (URL placeholder) and falls back to local-only when not configured
subscribeTopScores(limit, callback) attaches realtime onSnapshot listener to top scores by score desc
On game over, if score qualifies (score > current Top10 minimum or fewer than 10 entries), nickname prompt UI is shown; nickname validated 3-12 chars with profanity blocklist
Leaderboard panel renders Top 10 with rank, nickname, score; current player's row highlighted; entries within 24h show NEW badge
Code degrades gracefully when Firebase config is unset (game still playable, leaderboard panel shows 'Leaderboard offline — set Firebase config to enable')
node --check src/leaderboard.js passes

stories.title: Mobile + accessibility polish
acceptanceCriteria: touchstart handler on canvas triggers jump (passive: false, preventDefault)
Mouse click on canvas also triggers jump
ARIA label on canvas describing the game state
Viewport meta tag for mobile present in index.html

stories.title: README.md and project metadata
acceptanceCriteria: README.md exists at project root
README explains how to run (open index.html or `npx serve`), controls, Firebase setup steps
README links to PRD.md
README includes section on Cloud Function expected request/response shape

stories.title: Firebase backend skeleton (rules + cloud function source)
acceptanceCriteria: firebase/firestore.rules file exists with read-allow / write-deny policy (only via CF)

firebase/functions/index.js implements submitScore Cloud Function with: speed validation (score/duration <= 25/sec), nickname length 3-12, profanity filter, max score cap 99999, basic IP rate limit comment
firebase/functions/package.json declares firebase-admin, firebase-functions deps
node --check firebase/functions/index.js passes
